protocol.host_identity: Apple M4 Pro from preserved S0 protocol; S2 records platform and CPU count; direct CPU-brand re-query unavailable in sandbox.
protocol.model: Logical coefficient, RHS, neighbor/self/output reads/writes, old-iterate passes when present, ground mirror, and compact mask/factor lookups. Counts table reads even when cached; assumes shared mask-index reuse; excludes cache-line/write-allocation effects and control overhead. Effective GB/s is not measured DRAM bandwidth.
